Vox’s Today, Explained co-hosts Sean Rameswaram and Noel King dig into the Texas Senate race and discuss Noel’s  two-day trip to get a firsthand look at how the Talarico and Paxton campaigns are battling it out in the final days before Election Day.  They discuss the culture war shaping the race and what voters are focusing on ahead of the midterm elections.
